title: How a Rumor Becomes a Headline

scenes.narration: A claim is not a fact. But give it enough repetition, and it starts to look like one.
scenes.headline: How a Rumor Becomes a Headline
scenes.subline: The short, boring path from a forum post to a front page.

scenes.narration: The path from a forum post to a headline is shorter than you think.
scenes.headline: A post becomes a thread. A thread becomes a story.
scenes.subline: Each step adds confidence, not evidence.

scenes.narration: First, a post. Then replies. Then an aggregator picks it up. Then a headline.
scenes.headline: Four hops from claim to front page
scenes.subline: No new reporting at any hop.

scenes.narration: In the first hour, the post was a question. By the third hour, it was a warning. By lunch, it was a fact.
scenes.headline: Three hours, three rewrites
scenes.subline: The claim gets shorter and more certain at every step.

events.s: A reply drops the question mark
The claim is now a fact

scenes.narration: The original post said a bug might affect some servers. The headline said every server was exposed.
scenes.headline: What was said vs. what was published
scenes.subline: The gap is where the certainty enters.

left.t: A bug might affect some servers

scenes.narration: The original post cited zero primary sources. The headline cited the post.
scenes.headline: Primary sources in the original claim
scenes.subline: No interviews, no documents, no data.

scenes.narration: A claim repeated is still a claim. Repetition is not verification.
scenes.headline: A claim repeated is still a claim.
scenes.subline: The editorial rule this video is built on.

scenes.narration: The fix is boring. Open the primary source. Read the method. Check the date. Then decide.
scenes.headline: The antidote is a primary source.
scenes.subline: It is slower than sharing. It is also the only thing that stops the loop.

scenes.narration: So before you share the next alarming headline, check the source. See you next time.
scenes.headline: Check the source before you share.
scenes.subline: A claim is not a fact until someone checks it.
